foreignQualification.feeBasis: Online filing fee of $270.00 for Form FL-01; paper filing costs $300.00 (the form and fee tables state both figures).
foreignQualification.formName: Application for Certificate of Registration of Foreign Limited Liability Company (Form FL-01)
foreignQualification.filedWith: Arkansas Secretary of State, Business and Commercial Services
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File the annual LLC franchise tax report (currently $150) with the Secretary of State and maintain a registered agent for service of process in Arkansas.

evidence.quote: Application for Certificate of Registration of Foreign Limited Liability Company FL-01 $270.00 $300.00 ONLINE PDF
APPLICATIO N FOR CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION OF FOREIGN LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY
attach payment and mail or deliver to the Business and Commercial Services office
Limited Liability Company LLC or PLLC N/A $150 $150 ONLINE
The name and address of the registered agent of the Limited Liability Company upon whom service of process is authorized to be made in Arkansas
The Limited Liability Company shall deliver, with the completed application, a certificate of existence (or document of similar import)

notes: The record carries the online figure ($270) as the common filing path, with the paper price ($300) in feeBasis. The application must be accompanied by a certificate of existence from the home jurisdiction; the annual franchise tax report fee lives in the root states.json.
